Name: Valley Cultivation (beta)
Author: wer5865682
Description:
[b]Valley Cultivation[/b] brings xianxia, the Chinese fantasy tradition of cultivating immortality, to Stardew Valley. Begin as a mortal farmer, study the Qi Refining Manual, and advance through six realms. You can weave spells from the Five Elements, dedicate yourself to a Lifebound Sword, or venture underground to challenge six demon lords.
Cultivation also changes daily life on the farm. Send your tools out to work, plant array banners to nurture crops, and refine herbs into elixirs. An optional farm type gives you a home among the clouds that grows alongside you.
[b]Beta 0.28.3 • Single-player • English and Simplified Chinese[/b]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*]Extract the ValleyCultivation folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, then launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Start or load a single-player save. On a regular farm, sleep one night after first loading the mod, then step outside the farmhouse. An old friend will bring you the Qi Refining Manual. Read it and press the semicolon key to open the Celestial Pivot, your cultivation panel.[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 or later is optional. It lets you change keybinds and gameplay settings in-game.
[b]1. The Six Realms[/b]
Qi Refining → Foundation → Golden Core → Nascent Soul → Soul Formation → Spirit Roaming
[spoiler]
Qi Refining — Your step grows lighter. You move faster and learn your first five elemental spells.
Foundation — Swing your axe, pickaxe, hoe, and watering can faster. Five more spells become available, and you can choose the sword path.
Golden Core — Learn the final five spells and unlock combination arts. You can also spend 100 Qi to guide a tool for three in-game hours. It works on its own and follows you between locations. A guided Scythe harvests one tile per swing, a Golden Scythe sweeps 3×3, and an Iridium Scythe sweeps 5×5. Flowers and fruit trees are protected by default.
Nascent Soul — Blink through a rift to a clear spot nearby.
Soul Formation — Your blink reaches farther and costs less Qi.
Spirit Roaming — Stand still and send your spirit out to gather wild forage from your current location. Anything your pack cannot hold stays where it grew.[/spoiler]
[b]2. Five Elements Spellcraft[/b]
[spoiler]
Learn 15 spells across Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. At Golden Core, they open into 20 combination arts. A good way to discover how they work is to try two different follow-ups on the same opening spell.
Trap an enemy with Water Prison, then strike the bubble with Golden Glint. The water bursts into two great palms that slam together around the target and scatter spray across nearby enemies. This is Twin-Tide Prison Break.
Now start with Water Prison again, but follow it with Woodheart Art. A Purewater Lotus blooms from the bubble and flies back to restore your health and stamina.
You can summon a training dummy from the Celestial Pivot to try these combinations on the farm.[/spoiler]
[b]3. The Sword Path[/b]
[spoiler]
At Foundation, you can swear a permanent sword oath. Build a Sword Furnace, choose a blade from your pack, and refine it into your Lifebound Sword. Your chosen blade passes on its base stats. You can still use elemental spells while preparing the furnace and choosing your sword. Completing the final binding seals those spells for good.
Your sword arts grow through practice. Early on, each slash can send a crescent of sword Qi through your enemies. Later, you can split your sword Qi into three flying blades that pursue their own targets. The final art, Extinction, spends all your Qi to call down six waves of sword rain.[/spoiler]
[b]4. The Six Demon Lords[/b]
[spoiler]
Once you have studied the Qi Refining Manual, breaking rocks on eligible floors 21–119 of the Mines can reveal Ancient Jade Steps. Approach and right-click to enter. The first five guardians each have their own domain and entrance animation.
• Basalt Crag Monarch — Celadon Grotto
• Blackwater Shell Sovereign — Star-Sunken Marsh
• Myriad-Root Tree Patriarch — Wither-Bloom Shrine
• Geng-Metal White Tiger — White-Emperor Barrow
• Crimson-Flame Fox Sovereign — Crimson Glow Palace
The sixth guardian is the Abyssal Thunder Dragon. From floor 50 onward in Skull Cavern, breaking a rock on an eligible floor can open a Dragonvein Rift into the Sunken Thunder Abyss.
Defeat the guardian to open the golden coffer. If you need to retreat, return to the jade steps.[/spoiler]
[b]5. Alchemy[/b]
Alchemy is playable, though it is still one of the rougher parts of the beta and needs more polish.
[spoiler]
Place an Alchemy Furnace, choose a recipe, and supply its ingredients and Spirit Stones for fuel. Recipes include breakthrough pills, Five-Element pills, seasonal pills, and pills that support your cultivation.
Two recipes matter early on. The Foundation Pill helps you break through from Qi Refining to Foundation. To form your Golden Core, refine the five elemental pills into a Realm-Breaker Pill.
An Herb-Spirit Array can take over routine brewing. Give the Herb Spirit a recipe and ingredients, and it will tend idle furnaces within the array and collect the finished pills.[/spoiler]
[b]6. Optional Farm Type · Dongtian Farm[/b]
[spoiler]
Install the Dongtian Farm companion mod and choose its farm type when creating a new save. You begin on a single mountain peak above a sea of clouds. You can see the other peaks long before you can set foot on them.
At Golden Core, channel Qi into the spirit tree to connect two more peaks. At Spirit Roaming, nurture the tree again to open the final two. What began as a home on one summit eventually becomes a farm spread across five.[/spoiler]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
I haven’t encountered any conflicts with other mods so far. If you run into one, please let me know which mods you were using and what happened. Reports are welcome.
Testing so far has focused on single-player. Multiplayer has not been tested.
[b]A note from the author[/b]
This started as a spur-of-the-moment AI project. My part was mostly coming up with ideas, and I used AI to turn them into a playable mod. Quite a bit is still unfinished, and some of the numbers may be off. If a breakthrough feels too steep or one spell makes the others barely worth using, I’d genuinely like to hear about it.
[b]What might come next?[/b]
• A storyline of its own?
• Artifact refining, perhaps as a way to take your Lifebound Sword further after forging it?
• Spiritual roots or a talent tree, so two farmers following the same path could grow up to play differently?

[b]《星露修仙》[/b]把仙侠修行带进了星露谷。你从一介凡人起步，读一卷《炼气术》，打坐吐纳，逐境突破。你可以参悟五行，把先后两道法术接成一式合诀；也可以立下剑誓，将自己选中的一柄剑炼作本命。矿井深处还藏着六位妖王，各自镇守一方秘境。
修行也会改变农场里的日子。你可以让农具腾空干活，在田边立阵催长作物，或架起丹炉，把收来的药材炼成丹药。另有可选的洞天农场，让云海之上的家园随你的境界一起扩大。
[b]测试版 0.28.3 • 单人游玩 • 支持简体中文与英文[/b]
[b]安装方法[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]将压缩包中的 ValleyCultivation 文件夹解压到星露谷的 Mods 目录，再通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[*]新建或载入单人存档。在普通农场，首次载入模组后睡上一晚，次日走出农舍，便会遇见前来赠送《炼气术》的故人。读过功法后，按默认的分号键打开修炼面板「大道玄枢」。[/*]
[/list]可选安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 或更高版本，方便在游戏内调整快捷键和玩法设置。
[b]一、境界划分[/b]
炼气 → 筑基 → 金丹 → 元婴 → 化神 → 神游
[spoiler]
炼气｜引气入体，脚步渐轻。移动速度提升，并习得最初的五门五行法术。
筑基｜真元入器。挥动斧、镐、锄头和水壶更加利落，再开五门法术，也可在此境立誓修剑。
金丹｜解锁最后五门单术与五行合诀，也可施展金丹御器。花费 100 灵气，便能驾驭一件工具随行三个游戏小时，自动作业，换场景也会跟来。普通御镰每刀收一格，金镰刀横扫 3×3 格，铱镰刀横扫 5×5 格。默认保护鲜花和果树。
元婴｜缩地瞬移。越过一道裂隙，转瞬落在附近选中的空地上。
化神｜远遁之术更进一步，瞬移距离更远，消耗的灵气也更少。
神游｜元神出窍。人物驻足入定，元神代你采回当前场景的野生采集物；背包装不下的会留在原地。[/spoiler]
[b]二、五行法术[/b]
[spoiler]
金、木、水、火、土共十五门单术，金丹后可施展二十式合诀。想弄清五行如何相接，可以从同一颗水泡试起。
先用水牢术困住敌人，再以金芒术击破水泡。碎水从两侧扬起，化作一双水掌朝敌人猛然合拢，余浪溅向四周。这一式叫「双潮破牢」。
换个接法：同样先放水牢术，第二招改用木心术。水泡里会开出一朵莲花，飞回身边，为你恢复生命与体力。这一式叫「净水生莲」。
想自己摸索搭配，可以在「大道玄枢」里唤出测试木桩，就地试招。[/spoiler]
[b]三、剑修系统[/b]
[spoiler]
筑基后可以立下剑誓，一旦立誓，便是永久择道。你要亲手铸成剑炉，从行囊中选出一柄剑，再把它炼为本命飞剑。原剑的基础属性会成为飞剑的根骨。铸炉、择剑期间依然可以施展五行法术，直到本命飞剑真正炼成，法术才会永久封存。
剑诀要靠一次次出剑来领悟。起初是挥剑时随锋而出的月牙剑气，往后可修至「剑光分化」，分出三道飞剑自行追敌。最终一式「灭生」会倾尽灵气，引六轮剑雨落下。[/spoiler]
[b]四、六大妖王[/b]
[spoiler]
习得《炼气术》后，在普通矿井第 21–119 层符合条件的楼层碎石，有机会发现青玉古阶。靠近后右键即可踏入秘境。前五位妖王各有自己的领地与登场演出。
• 玄岩蟹君 —— 青玉遗府
• 玄泽鳄君 —— 沉星水泽
• 万根树祖 —— 枯荣古祠
• 庚金白虎 —— 白帝兵冢
• 离火狐尊 —— 赤霞离宫
第六位是镇守沉雷龙渊的玄霆龙君。自骷髅洞穴第 50 层起，在符合条件的楼层碎石，有机会打开通往龙渊的龙脉裂隙。
击败镇守妖王后，记得上前开启金色宝匣。若要中途撤离，也可循青阶返回。[/spoiler]
[b]五、炼丹系[/b]
目前炼丹已经可以游玩，不过这部分还比较粗糙，有待继续打磨。
[spoiler]
放置丹炉，选择丹方，备齐药材，再以灵石作炉火燃料，即可开炉。现有丹方分为破境、五行、四时和辅修四类。
初入仙途时，有两道丹方尤其要紧。炼气圆满后，需备一枚筑基丹叩开筑基关口。到了筑基圆满，则要先炼齐五行灵丹，再将它们合炼为一枚破境丹，方能凝就金丹。
若想把日常炉火交给药灵照看，可以布下药灵阵。交付药材、指定丹方后，药灵会接手阵内空闲的丹炉，替你开炉、收丹。[/spoiler]
[b]六、可选内容 · 洞天农场[/b]
[spoiler]
安装配套的「洞天农场」模组后，可在创建新存档时选择这一农场类型。开局只有云海中的一座主峰。隔云相望的几座山头，起初看得见，却走不过去。
修至金丹，向仙树灌注灵气，便能接通另外两峰。修至神游，再度滋养仙树，最后两峰也会开放。从一座主峰落脚，到五峰连成自己的洞天，可用的农场面积会随修为一步步扩大。[/spoiler]
[b]关于兼容性[/b]
目前我在游玩中暂未发现与其他模组的冲突。如果你遇到了问题，欢迎告诉我当时使用了哪些模组、具体发生了什么，方便我排查。
[b]作者的话[/b]
这是一个临时起意做出来的 AI 作品。我主要是出了一些自己想玩的点子，再借助 AI 把它们做进游戏。目前还有相当一部分内容没有完善，数值也可能不太合适。如果你觉得某次突破格外难熬，或者某招强到其他法术都没了出场机会，我很想听听你的实际体验。
[b]以后可能会做些什么？[/b]
• 给这段修仙之路写一段自己的剧情？
• 做一套炼器系统，让已经炼成的本命飞剑还能更进一步？
• 加入灵根，或者做一棵天赋树，让走同一条修行路的两个人，也能练出不同的玩法？
